description: The Italian Aerospace Research Centre publishes eight CSV tables of operating measurements from three centrifugal pumps feeding demineralised water to boilers in its research heating plant. The tables cover selected operating days in April, June and October 2024. Each timestamped row records motor and pump vibration, temperatures, outlet pressure and ambient conditions; the deposit also lists motor and pump nameplate ratings. Zenodo provides the files freely under CC BY 4.0. These observations can calibrate pump digital twins, test soft sensors or set operating ranges in plant simulations. The files represent normal operation on three days, with pump C off on 30 October. They cannot establish failure rates or a full seasonal duty cycle. Sensor values were not downloaded or tested. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified. The site coverage is one research heating plant in Italy, across those three operating days.
name: Centrifugal Pump Dataset
notes: G4-0505; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
